title: Principal of Least Privilege rollout and pen-test closeout
creator: Asha Patel
description: Close out of recent external penetration test and rollout of least-privilege RBAC v2 changes across admin surfaces. This ticket consolidates remediation actions across RBAC, audit logging, SSO/SAML flows, and admin console controls. Objectives: 1) Implement rapid mitigations called out by pen-test report (session fixation fixes, admin API gating, audit detail retention), 2) Complete RBAC v2 policy rollout with scoped role bindings and migration scripts, 3) Harden SSO/SAML admin endpoints and validate logout/relay behaviors, 4) Enhance audit log fidelity and tamper-evidence, 5) Produce verification artifacts and sign-off for security team and compliance. This ticket coordinates engineering changes, tests, and final security review required for release. Links: Pen-test report (private) - https://redwood-confluence.internal/sec/pen-test/feb-2025, Playbook PR - https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4621, RBAC migration script - https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/8f3a2b7
acceptance_criteria: All pen-test findings tagged for engineering are addressed or have documented compensating controls
RBAC v2 role schema deployed to staging and can be toggled per-org via feature flag
Migration script executed on staging + rollback tested; DB migration runbook documented
Admin console and admin APIs enforce scoped role checks; privilege-escalation tests pass
SAML login/logout/relay edge cases fixed and validated against enterprise IdP suite
Audit logs capture actor, target, decision, and K/V snapshots for admin actions for 90 days
Tamper-evidence: archived logs pushed to immutable storage and verified by checksum process
Security team performed threat-model review and signed off; pen-test vendor re-check scheduled
